description: An oil-painting style scene of a racecourse. Racehorses with jockeys in coloured silks gallop on the left across churned green turf, with a crowd of spectators in the stands behind them. On the right, a woman in a long black Edwardian dress and wide-brimmed hat leans over a white rail, facing the track, with stormy grey sky above. Top-hatted men stand at the right edge. No visible text, no frame.
